title: Lost My Artist so AI Helped Me Make a Visual Novel - Guncade
author: SirLoin85
selftext: While working on a platformer my artist bailed after completing a portion of the work. The cost sucked up much of what would have been used to make the demo, so we turned to another project that could be done cheaper in the mean time and created a visual novel influenced by VA-11 HALL-A Cyberpunk Bartender using Leonardo AI for all of the artwork. Now, GUNCADE is in NextFest! [https://store.steampowered.com/app/2398950/Guncade/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/2398950/Guncade/)

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body:
"Why don't you hire a real artist"

Artist bails. Artist skips milestones. Artist had another gig in the way...

comments.author: Delyzr
comments.body: Isn't AI art banned on steam ?

replies.author: SirLoin85
replies.body: No, they recently put out a policy about it. You just have to declare it on your store page that the game uses AI.

replies.author: MTOMalley
replies.body: Not anymore. They backpedaled and now allow you to self-report if you're using AI.

replies.author: MTOMalley
replies.body: To gamedevs I suppose, no. Kinda expected. Every company is putting out models to get ahead of the laws. Gamedevs are pushing a lot of the AI stuff too. From art to dialogue. 2D, 3D, Audio!
